text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This original research article focuses on spatially explicit land use change (LUC) modeling for the entire country of Italy, implementing a modified CLUE-S model (LUC@CMCC). It conducts an ensemble forecasting with 32 simulations combining multiple future scenarios (climate projections, demographic trends, policy options) to predict LUC hot-spots by 2100. The study includes quantitative accuracy assessments (logistic regression ROC AUC ~0.86), spatially explicit outputs at 500 m resolution, and detailed multi-scale analysis (administrative, biogeographical, watershed). It meets all core inclusion criteria: explicit national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LUC prediction, multiple quantitative future scenarios with comparison, spatial modeling with quantitative metrics, and mapped LUC projections. It is not a review and does not meet exclusion criteria. Therefore, it is categorized as OK.)
